Carnival Cruise Lines / Commerce & design systems

Complex orders. Simpler operations.

An end-to-end experience for agents managing guest purchases.

Senior UX/UI & Product DesignerJuan Carvajal
THE STARTING POINT

Carnival Cruise Lines

A fragmented tool ecosystem needed a shared way to search products, create orders and handle post-purchase changes.

PROJECT CONTEXT
01 / The challenge02 / The solution03 / Decisions04 / The impact
01

The challenge

Centralize the order-management journey while preserving accuracy across systems and continuity across channels.

02

The solution

I designed flows, wireframes, prototypes and specifications for a SAP-based OMS. The UX/UI strategy connected the modules through a unified design system and coordinated developer handoff.

03

Decisions that make the difference

01

Connect the full journey, from catalog to post-purchase changes.

02

Unify components and interactions on a SAP foundation.

03

Include accessibility, responsive behavior and developer documentation.

04 / The impact

>30% less order-management time

The original case reports a reduction of over 30% in average order-management time, alongside a shared component source for the ecosystem.
